mapper.sql: FROM transport_tasks t JOIN box_ownerships o ON o.box_id=t.box_id AND o.owner_type='ENTERPRISE' JOIN enterprises e ON e.id=o.enterprise_id WHERE e.admin_user_id=#{user}
mapper.select: SELECT t.* ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.sql: box_id=#{box} AND ts_src='SNTP' AND device_ts IS NOT NULL AND time_uncertainty_ms IS NOT NULL AND time_uncertainty_ms>=0 AND CAST(device_ts AS DECIMAL(20,0))-CAST(time_uncertainty_ms AS DECIMAL(20,0))>=#{start} AND CAST(device_ts AS DECIMAL(20,0))+CAST(time_uncertainty_ms AS DECIMAL(20,0))<#{end}
mapper.select: SELECT id,device_ts,payload FROM telemetry WHERE AND JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(payload,'one','$.env') ORDER BY device_ts DESC,id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT id,device_ts,type,level FROM events WHERE ORDER BY device_ts DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id,username FROM users WHERE enabled=1 AND role_code='COURIER' ORDER BY username
SELECT * FROM transport_guest_access WHERE task_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT task_id,session_expires_at FROM transport_guest_access WHERE session_hash=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_guest_access(task_id,code_hash,issued_at) VALUES(#{id},#{hash},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE code_hash=#{hash},issued_at=#{now},session_hash=NULL,session_expires_at=NULL
